title: fix(scenarios): the citation grader accepts a multi-word object named as words in a source line
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"hotlong"} -->
_Requested by **Jack** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01EF41AQooqveF2DGD8nqPzS?thread=cmsg_01EF41AQooqveF2DGD8nqPzSPrBAnB7RiEHAGp5rsqSX3q)_

Fixes #37684

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读
- 用户无感：这是内部评测工具的评分修正，回答里写「Source: Invoice Line」「Source: Expense Claim」这种多词对象名，现在算注明了出处。
- 为云端智能体效果专题服务：发票卡、差旅卡的「问数」分数不再被错扣，Claude Code 和云端智能体的对比数字更准。
- 出错只影响评测评分，匹配仍只看出处行，写错对象照样判没注明，可直接撤回。
- 要你做什么：无。

## What changes

`citationLabels` (`packages/qa/scenarios/src/runner/namespace.ts`) labels each namespaced object by its card name and,
when that name has more than one word, by the words themselves: `demoinvoice_invoice_line` → `['invoice_line',
'invoice line']`, `demotravel_expense_claim` → `['expense_claim', 'expense claim']`. A one-word name gets no second
label (`democrm_account` → `['account']`, unchanged).

The grader is untouched. `gradeRun` (`src/score/scenario-run-grade.ts`) already matches a label case-insensitively and
only inside a source line (`来源：…` / `Source: …`), never anywhere in the reply, so the card's step 2 already held. The
live run (`runHalf`, four call sites in `orchestrate.ts`) and the gallery export (`export/transcript.ts`, which regrades
each turn and refuses on any difference) both read `citationLabels(original)`. They take the new label with no change,
and a recording graded by this version exports as before.

## Acceptance notes

- **Premise, re-measured on `origin/main` 6d106a1a**: `namespace.ts:133` mapped `${ns}_${name}` → `[name]` as stated.
- **"The card's object label" does not exist.** A card declares its objects by name only (`expect.objects`). Every
  `label` in a card belongs to a dataset, a measure or a dimension. The other half of step 1, the served label (the built
  artifact's object `label`, or `describe_object`'s), was set aside with the seat: the run record does not keep the
  artifact, so a live grade using it could not be reproduced by the export's regrade. The de-underscored name covers
  every reply shape on the card. Follow-up, if the eval thread finds replies citing a built label that differs from the
  name:
  - **B**: `gradeRun` also takes an object `label` from the turn's own tool outputs (reproducible from the recording;
    covers only the labels the turn looked up).
  - **C**: `runHalf` adds the artifact's object labels and the record keeps them per half for the export (a record
    shape change).
- Unchanged and out of scope: a source line naming a longer object still cites the shorter one it contains ("Source:
  Invoice Line" also names `invoice`). This was true before this change, through the bare name.
- Re-scoring the cloud#5031 recordings is the eval thread's job (the card's step 3).

## Tests

Local, on head c1905120 (branched from `origin/main` 6d106a1a):

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/scenarios build && pnpm --filter @objectstack/scenarios typecheck && pnpm --filter
  @objectstack/scenarios test` under `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh` → `VERDICT command-exit 0`; typecheck exit 0;
  Test Files 44 passed (44), Tests 1362 passed (1362)
- eslint `--no-inline-config` over the 2 changed `.ts` files → exit 0
- New pins, `test/runner/units.test.ts`, describe "a multi-word object is cited by its name as words, in a source line
  only (#37684)", over the real invoice and travel cards:
  - the labels each object gets (one-word names unchanged);
  - the card's three reply shapes graded cited: "Source: Invoice", "Source: Invoice Line" (also `来源：INVOICE LINES`),
    "Source: Expense Claim (demotravel_expense_claim)", "Source: Expense Claim";
  - ⛔ the wrong-object control: "Source: Invoice" for the invoice-line figure and "Source: Claim Line" for the expense
    claim figure stay uncited, and so do the right words in the reply's prose rather than in a source line.
- Ablation (committed first; `citationLabels` reverted to `[name]`; restored with `git checkout HEAD --`; `git status
  --porcelain` empty after): 2 of the 3 new tests turn red (`expected false to be true` on "Source: Invoice Line"; the
  label map differs). The control stays green both ways, as a control should.
- `node scripts/pm/overlap-check.mjs --branch=HEAD` → `VERDICT clean exit 0`; `check-changeset-no-major` and
  `check-empty-changeset --base origin/main` pass.

## Verification

Two-minute check: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/scenarios exec vitest run test/runner/units.test.ts -t "multi-word
object"` → 3 passed.

Read first: `src/runner/namespace.ts` (`citationLabels`), then the grader's match at
`src/score/scenario-run-grade.ts:618-623`.

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic.
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes.
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed. (Not touched.)
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
